title: Mokuʻula restoration master plan
summary: At the August 6 meeting, a commissioner said they were very supportive of the restoration project, and the commission took no action. The department's first step is removing the courts and parking lot, with archaeological and cultural monitors on all work and topsoil placed over cleared areas. It is working with the Salvation Army to acquire land the group still owns, and the master plan, being developed until June 2027, will build in the commission's 2019 recommendations.
